scope: independent rolling mechanism, not historical global top3
initialization: same pilot parent including critic and optimizer
initial_bank: historical top3 from frozen pilot inputs
snapshot_rule: fixed end-of-window snapshots; no test or validation eligibility selection
membership_rule: anchor + most recent up to2 completed-window snapshots; fill initial empty slots with historical rank2 then3; deduplicate IDs and exact state tensors
freeze: independent eval copies with requires_grad false; immutable for next50 updates; evaluated on each new candidate Z
evaluation: same pilot cached independent final test256 per4 groups; best secondary only
refresh_cost: separate wallseconds for validation/snapshot/write/load/freeze; summed with update cost
comparison: paired against existing geo/k3 pilots; not original formal WDRO
